synthesis.procedure: A solution of Dy(SCN)3·6H2O (66.7 mg, 0.15 mmol) and H2opch (40.5 mg, 0.15 mmol) in MeOH/CH2Cl2 (15 mL, 1:2 v/v) was stirred with triethylamine (0.5 mmol) for 6 h. The saffron-yellow solution was left to stand for slow evaporation of the solvent. Orange single crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction formed after several days. Yield: 24 mg (32%, based on the metal salt).

properties.summary: Compound 2 is a pentanuclear Dy(III) SMM with a single thermally activated relaxation process (Δ = 197 K, τ0 = 3.2×10^-9 s), a quantum-tunneling regime below 3 K (τQTM = 3.5 s), and a spindle-shaped hysteresis loop at 1.9 K. Room-temperature χMT is below the uncoupled Dy5 value and magnetization does not saturate.
